name: [UPTD AVA FREE X250 + COIL] MOUNT RAGON
desc:
🌄 Welcome to MOUNT RAGON 

NEW UPDATE !!
EVERY WEEK WILL ALWAYS CHANGE




A fictional mountain with warm undertones full of surprises.
Climb while enjoying the beautiful scenery, explore exciting challenges, and enjoy the fun with friends. Suitable for beginner to intermediate climbers!

✨ Main features: 
🏔️ Carry/Carry Player - together reach the peak of wonder. 
🎯 Easy Challenges - Medium - fun and challenging, without causing frustration. 
🔮 Special Peak - find a magnificent statue with a stunning purple aura. 

🔧 Still in development stage! 
More updates, unique features, and new challenges will be coming soon. Don't forget to invite your friends to conquer the summit together!
